Class CreateBillsFromPayments.CreateBill

private class CreateBillsFromPayments.CreateBill
implements Queueable

Queueable job that creates a bill for a single account by invoking the FLOW_CREATEBILLSFROMPAYMENTS Flow, then chains another job for the next account in the stack until all accounts are processed.
